thread:
Marta: Heads-up team — we're deprecating the legacy embeddings param `model_hint` in favor of `embedding_model` across SDKs and docs. This is to align names with our model catalog and avoid ambiguity between retrieval and embed pipelines.

Jin: TL;DR for SDKs: add `embedding_model` param (string). If caller provides `model_hint`, SDKs will map it to `embedding_model` for the 90-day grace window and emit a deprecation warning. After 90 days calls using only `model_hint` will return a 422-like error. We'll ship py/js/go minor releases next week.

Rhea: Docs plan: migration guide, mapping table (old hint -> canonical model id), quick grep commands for repos, and sample code snippets. I'll publish the guide and a small FAQ about fallback behavior.

Omar: Support note: prepare KB article with diagnostic steps. Common customer issues will be: hard-coded param names in older clients, CI jobs pinning old SDKs, and platform connectors. We'll offer a temporary compat flag for Dedicated customers for up to 30 days beyond the 90-day window.

Sam: Legal/compliance: no contract changes expected. If customers rely on named guarantees in contracts, we'll inform account teams to flag renewals. All customer notifications should reference the migration timeline and the mapping table.

Jin: Example (py):
`resp = client.embeddings(input, embedding_model="text-embed-003")`
Grace behavior: if `model_hint` present and `embedding_model` absent -> SDK sets `embedding_model = map_hint(model_hint)` and logs a single deprecation event per process.

Marta: Timeline:
- Day 0: announcement + docs draft.
- Day 7: SDK previews with warning logs.
- Day 30: docs + email templates to affected customers.
- Day 90: server-side enforcement begins for hosted endpoints; Dedicated can opt-in or request extension.

Rhea: I'll add example grep: `git grep "model_hint" -n` and a small codemod to replace it automatically. Posting in #docs in 2 hours.

Omar: Support will open a rapid-response rotation during Day 80-100 to help migrations.

Marta: Please react with :white_check_mark: if you've read. If you own an integration, ping me directly.

deploy-bot: Draft published: Embeddings param migration guide (staging) — https://docs.redwood.ai/embeddings-migration (staging) :page_facing_up:
